purpose: Action-focused migration report containing only build blockers and dependencies/frameworks that may require source or configuration changes. Routine dependency updates are excluded.

build_blockers.action: Update Maven compiler/source/target configuration to Java 21 and scan source for removed or incompatible JDK APIs.

framework_migrations.reason: Spring Boot 3 requires the Jakarta ecosystem and introduces framework/API migration changes.
framework_migrations.action: For an incremental migration, first stabilize on 2.7.18. For the Java 21 modernization, migrate to a compatible Spring Boot 3.x release and address Jakarta/API changes.

framework_migrations.reason: Major Spring Security generations change security configuration APIs.
framework_migrations.action: Align Spring Security with the selected Spring Boot version and scan/update deprecated security configuration such as WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter and older authorization APIs.

framework_migrations.reason: Spring Framework major-version migration must remain aligned with Spring Boot rather than independently selecting the newest repository version.
framework_migrations.action: Upgrade through the Spring Boot-managed dependency set and resolve affected Spring API/configuration changes.

critical_dependencies.name: jakarta.persistence:jakarta.persistence-api
critical_dependencies.reason: The persistence API generation changes with the Spring Boot 3/Jakarta migration.
critical_dependencies.action: Do not blindly upgrade to the reported latest version. Align JPA with the selected Spring Boot/Hibernate stack and update affected persistence APIs/imports.

critical_dependencies.name: io.jsonwebtoken:jjwt
critical_dependencies.reason: The version gap includes JWT API changes that can break existing authentication/token parsing code.
critical_dependencies.action: Upgrade JJWT together with the required JWT parser/signing API changes and compile-test authentication code.

namespace_migrations.reason: Spring Boot 3 and the Jakarta ecosystem replace affected Java EE javax namespaces.
namespace_migrations.action: Scan Java source and update affected imports/APIs such as javax.persistence, javax.servlet, javax.validation, javax.annotation and javax.transaction.
